scope: Proposition 5.2 (Corrected test lifts) of the manuscript “The unique threshold bound state of the SU(N) BFSS model” (preprints/The-unique-threshold-bound-state-of-the-SU-N-BFSS-model-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 270 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7a4b12bd2a7e8902), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 29. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix m ≥ 0, a unit spinor v, and a partition C with k ≥ 2. For every f ∈ TC there are gauge-singlet graph-domain states Ih,v,m f, defined for all sufficiently large h, such that ∥Ih,v,m f − Jh f ∥ −→ 0, ∥Dv(h, m)Ih,v,m f − Jh(DC v (m)f )∥ −→ 0. (5.3) The construction is linear on any fixed finite-dimensional space of tests, and both conclusions hold simul- taneously for every fixed finite test family. In particular, all inner products of their leading states and indicated charge outputs converge to the corresponding profile inner products. For distinct partitions the families, including their outputs, are asymptotically orthogonal. The leading identifications intertwine block permutations and Spin(3) × Spin(6); each fixed symmetry may be passed through these norm limits. The lifts may depend on v and m.
